text:
pagerbot: ALERT: GPU_POOL_EU-WEST-2 | capacity_exhaustion detected

pagerbot: Summary: 95% GPU utilization across pool 'eu-west-2-gpu-a'. Autoscaler failed to reach target due to provider API 429s. Queue depth growing -> 8.2k waiting requests. Paging on-call.

marta_ops: I'm on it. grabbing logs and looking at autoscaler controller.

deepak_oncall: +1 oncall here — currently seeing repeated 429s from provider when trying to provision VMs: 
```
2026-03-15T03:12:08Z provider-api: 429 TooManyRequests createNode pool=eu-west-2-gpu-a
2026-03-15T03:12:10Z autoscaler: retry attempt 4 backoff=8s
```
I'll start draining low-priority jobs and enable queued-request throttling.

ben_platform: Are we able to route to a backup pool (eu-west-2-gpu-b) or fallback to quantized variants?

cliara_sre: We have standby pool but it's configured in another account — need a cross-account approval. Not instant. Fallback: route to smaller instance types (higher latency but available) and enable model-variant fallback. Pushing a routing policy now.

marta_ops: Action: temporarily lower concurrency limit for free-tier -> `max_concurrency=2` for token-gen routes to cut tail. Applying now.

deepak_oncall: Done. Also reduced prefetch batching window from 50ms -> 20ms to free up slots: `BATCH_WINDOW_MS=20`.

sam_csm: Seeing customer impact on 4 customers with SLO alerting active (one enterprise account). ETA to restore within 20m? Customers reporting elevated latencies and some 503s. I pinged CS to prepare comms.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Queue length peaked at 9.1k, now drifting down to 5.4k after throttles and concurrency cuts. Autoscaler still receiving 429s.

ben_platform: I'm going to engage provider support but we should avoid manual scale if provider keeps throttling. Proposal: spin up a short-lived pool in us-west-1 and route a subset of traffic (non-compliance sensitive) there. Need approval.

marta_ops: Approve routing split for non-sensitive traffic. deepak, can you create a canary route (10%) to us-west-1 and set model-variant to q4_0 for cost/throughput tradeoff?

deepak_oncall: Creating canary: command: `redwood route create --from eu-west-2 --to us-west-1 --pct 10 --filters "!enterprise_strict" --model q4_0`
Result: queued, provider calls OK for us-west-1. Canary deployed in ~2m.

pagerbot: MONITOR: canary latency + success rates acceptable; queue in eu-west-2 continues to drop. Provider 429s subsiding — looks like a regional API throttling window.

cliara_sre: Root cause hypothesis: provider-side rate limiting on node create calls during a regional rebalancing event. Autoscaler didn't implement exponential jitter properly; raced with other customers.

ben_platform: Temporary mitigation checklist:
- throttled non-critical customers (done)
- route 10% to fallback region (done)
- lowered concurrency and batching (done)
- engaged provider support (in progress)
- enable autoscaler backoff with jitter fix (patch pending)

marta_ops: Evidence capture: attaching log snippets and autoscaler metrics (links). I'll kick off an incident bridge for follow-up and assign an action owner for the autoscaler fix.

deepak_oncall: I'll own the autoscaler patch (AUTO-429-jitter). ETA for PR: 3 hours. I'll also add a temporary circuit breaker to avoid aggressive retries on 429.

sam_csm: CS note: notified impacted customers, offering credits + status updates. Tracking a customer impact doc.

pagerbot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> partial. Core pool stabilized, queue decreasing, fallback routes active. Severity reduced from Sev2->Sev3.

marta_ops: Post-incident tasks (initial):
- deepak: autoscaler jitter and 429 backoff change -> PR + test (owner)
- ben: run a capacity failover drill to ensure cross-account standby pool can be promoted in <10m (owner)
- cliara: add autoscaler metrics and alert refinement for provider 429 spike (owner)
- sam: draft customer postmortem + comms for impacted accounts (owner)
- marta: update incident runbook with stand-by routing play and throttling knobs (owner)

deepak_oncall: noted. I'll include unit/integration tests that simulate provider 429s and validate exponential backoff + jitter.

ben_platform: I'll schedule a tabletop to review multi-region fallback and runbook paths. Proposed time: today 18:00 UTC.

marta_ops: Great. Any outstanding asks?

sam_csm: CS needs an ETA for full remediation (autoscaler fix) to give to customers. deepak?

deepak_oncall: ETA for merged fix -> 3 hours, staging roll -> 30m, prod rollout -> 45m after approval. Conservatively 4.5 hours to full fix.

marta_ops: ok I'll communicate that. Closing the live page — monitoring channel will remain open for postmortem. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: INCIDENT CLOSED (live) at 3987650105 — Severity downgraded, manual actions applied, followups assigned.
